description: A stereo rain bed: filtered noise through a reverb, with a width control over the result

params.text: Sets how thick the noise bed is, thin at the far left and heavy at the far right
A single tone control: turning it back from the centre sweeps a low-pass down, turning it forward sweeps a high-pass up, and the centre leaves the bed alone
Sets how much reverb is mixed in, dry at the far left and fully wet at the far right
Sets the stereo width, collapsing to mono at the far left, leaving the natural image at the centre and exaggerating the sides at the far right

inputs.text: Adds to the width knob, one volt moving the width by a fifth of a unit

notes: the module makes its own noise and takes no audio in; it sounds as soon as it is placed
the drawing on the panel changes with the settings
the module adds nothing to Rack's right-click menu in this build

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
